china-1925-6:p0530_3.rationale: Import duty rates and tariff units for silk piece goods, plushes, satins and ribbons; rates are the subject, silk is the material.

china-1925-6:p0530_4.rationale: Import duty rates for union shirtings and wool/cotton cloths; wool is a substantive material alongside cotton.

china-1925-6:p0531_1.rationale: Customs import duty schedule for sheep's wool and woollen goods and yarn.

china-1925-6:p0531_2.rationale: Import duty rates for a range of metals (brass, copper, iron and steel, antimony, aluminium); too many metals for specific tags to represent it.

china-1925-6:p0532_1.rationale: Import duty schedule mainly for iron and steel goods, plus lead, nickel and other metals. Some duty values are unreadable, but the structure establishes the intended rates.

china-1925-6:p0533_1.rationale: Import duty rates for tin, white metal and zinc products; tin is the first-listed metal and has a tag, zinc is covered only by the combined lead-and-zinc tag.

china-1925-6:p0533_2.rationale: Import duty rates on dried and fresh fishery and sea products. Many different products, so no specific tag is forced.

china-1925-6:p0533_3.rationale: Fragment of the import tariff with three provision items (bacon, baking powder, corned beef) and their duties.

china-1925-6:p0534_1.rationale: Import duty rates for canned goods, groceries and foodstuffs, listed by tariff unit.

china-1925-6:p0534_2.rationale: Import duty rates for spices, seeds, camphor and similar items, with cereals and flour listed as free. Mixed commodities, so no specific tag is chosen.
